name: Deathguard Humbert
summary: Deathguard Humbert is a Forsaken sentry stationed in Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills. Assigned to monitor the encroaching Alliance presence, he finds himself in an embarrassing predicament after losing his military gear to the dwarves of Dun Garok.

sections.title: A Guard Relieved of His Steel
sections.body: While tasked with maintaining Tarren Mill's perimeter against regional threats, Deathguard Humbert suffered a humiliating setback. Sent by High Executor Darthalia to watch Dun Garok from a hidden camp, he left one morning to gather firewood, and dwarven scouts from Dun Garok made off with his prized sword and assorted equipment, leaving the undead soldier desperate to salvage his pride and armament before high command takes notice.

faq.answer: Deathguard Humbert is a Forsaken warrior stationed as a scout and guard in Tarren Mill. His duties involve keeping an eye on hostile Alliance operations throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What happened to Humbert's sword and armor?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia sent Humbert to keep watch on Dun Garok from a distance. One morning he left his hidden camp to gather firewood, and when he returned, dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with his gear, including his precious sword.

faq.q: Why doesn't Humbert just recover his gear himself?
faq.answer: Dun Garok is heavily fortified with disciplined dwarven riflemen and mountaineers. A lone scout standing outside its trenches stands little chance, and Humbert cannot easily leave his post without answering for how he lost his kit in the first place.

angles.text: Recovering Humbert's lost sword strikes back against the bold dwarven foothold in Hillsbrad while preserving the dignity of Tarren Mill's garrison.
Forsaken soldiers are expected to serve the Dark Lady with unyielding vigilance, making Humbert's lapse of attention against the living an embarrassing blemish on the Deathguard.
